name: Maya — GLM prepared server
description: Run prepared Project Maya GLM-5.3-Flash packs. Import Maya JSON at the top of the model editor, then edit named controls or create a preset from prepared assets. Linux CUDA and experimental Windows/HIP; engine-native GPU selection, no verified VisLlama placement. Setup, compilation and calibration remain external.

fields.label: Prepared model format
fields.description: GLM pack prepared by Maya setup. The catalog path identifies this pack directory; this does not prepare GGUF files or create a pack. DeepSeek uses a separate contract and is not supported by this definition.

fields.label: Tokenizer directory
fields.description: Prepared tokenizer directory containing vocab.json, merges.txt and token_type.json.
fields.source: Project Maya prepared server / maya.py write_config / docs/SETTINGS.md (reviewed source hashes in definition evidence).

fields.label: Expert cache size
fields.description: Engine-native cache value, such as auto or a slot count. No value is forced by VisLlama.
fields.source: Project Maya prepared server / maya.py write_config / docs/SETTINGS.md (reviewed source hashes in definition evidence).

fields.label: Prefill chunk setting
fields.description: Engine-native value, such as auto, a token count, or auto:N when supported.
fields.source: Project Maya prepared server / maya.py write_config / docs/SETTINGS.md (reviewed source hashes in definition evidence).

fields.label: Context size (tokens)
fields.description: Full model context limit, not the resident KV window.
fields.source: Project Maya prepared server / maya.py write_config / docs/SETTINGS.md (reviewed source hashes in definition evidence).

fields.label: Resident KV window (tokens)
fields.description: Size of the KV window kept resident. This is not the full context size.
fields.source: Project Maya prepared server / maya.py write_config / docs/SETTINGS.md (reviewed source hashes in definition evidence).

fields.label: GPU selection (Maya device numbers)
fields.description: Comma-separated Maya device numbers, e.g. 0,2. Maya interprets these using its CUDA/HIP ordering. VisLlama does not translate them or verify physical placement. Select free GPUs when sharing with other models.
fields.source: Project Maya prepared server / maya.py write_config / docs/SETTINGS.md (reviewed source hashes in definition evidence).

fields.label: Layer / pipeline split points
fields.description: auto, or the first layer on each later GPU, e.g. 18 or 16,32. These are boundaries, not layer counts. Requires several selected GPUs. Maya verifies compatibility.
fields.source: Project Maya prepared server / maya.py write_config / docs/SETTINGS.md (reviewed source hashes in definition evidence).

fields.label: VRAM reserve (MiB)
fields.description: Native engine reserve for other programs. Does not enable VisLlama Calculated planning.
fields.source: Project Maya prepared server / maya.py write_config / docs/SETTINGS.md (reviewed source hashes in definition evidence).

fields.label: Later GPUs VRAM reserve (MiB)
fields.description: Separate native reserve for later layer-split GPUs.
fields.source: Project Maya prepared server / maya.py write_config / docs/SETTINGS.md (reviewed source hashes in definition evidence).

fields.label: Maya inference executable
fields.description: Prepared GLM inference binary: build/maya.exe on Windows, build/maya on Linux, or build-hip/maya for HIP. Separate from the server Python interpreter. Do not select maya-ds4.
fields.source: Project Maya prepared server / maya.py write_config / docs/SETTINGS.md (reviewed source hashes in definition evidence).

fields.label: Working directory
fields.description: Blank uses the registered installation directory in Create mode.
fields.source: Project Maya prepared server / maya.py write_config / docs/SETTINGS.md (reviewed source hashes in definition evidence).

fields.label: Native library folders
fields.description: Folders used to find DLLs/shared libraries. Imported folders are kept. Add, browse or detect folders without editing JSON.
fields.source: Project Maya prepared server / maya.py write_config / docs/SETTINGS.md (reviewed source hashes in definition evidence).

fields.label: Default reasoning effort
fields.source: Project Maya prepared server / maya.py write_config / docs/SETTINGS.md (reviewed source hashes in definition evidence).

fields.label: Fit output tokens to context
fields.source: Project Maya prepared server / maya.py write_config / docs/SETTINGS.md (reviewed source hashes in definition evidence).

fields.label: Full native argument array (advanced)
fields.description: Preserved native argument tokens. Named controls below display matching values; editing one replaces only its corresponding option. Unknown tokens stay unchanged.
fields.source: Project Maya prepared server / maya.py write_config / docs/SETTINGS.md (reviewed source hashes in definition evidence).

fields.label: Prepared GLM pack directory
fields.description: Pack created by Maya setup, with its model index and tokenizer. Import the generated Maya JSON to fill this and the remaining paths.
fields.source: Project Maya maya.py / docs/SETTINGS.md; see definition evidence.

fields.label: GPU backend
fields.description: cuda for NVIDIA, hip for an already prepared experimental HIP installation. Changing this does not compile or install another backend.
fields.source: Project Maya maya.py / docs/SETTINGS.md; see definition evidence.

fields.label: KV streaming
fields.description: on streams the full latent cache through RAM while retaining a resident GPU window; off keeps the native non-streaming mode.
fields.source: Project Maya maya.py / docs/SETTINGS.md; see definition evidence.

fields.label: Concurrent request slots
fields.description: Requests served concurrently by one Maya model, separate from running multiple model processes. Extra slots consume memory.
fields.source: Project Maya maya.py / docs/SETTINGS.md; see definition evidence.

fields.label: Expert profile file
fields.description: Existing expert profile, preserved on import. VisLlama does not generate one.
fields.source: Project Maya maya.py / docs/SETTINGS.md; see definition evidence.

fields.label: DFlash2 drafter GGUF
fields.description: Optional prepared compatible drafter. Import its configuration to retain calibrated settings. This does not download or calibrate it; hardware and model licensing requirements still apply.
fields.source: Project Maya maya.py / docs/SETTINGS.md; see definition evidence.

fields.label: System RAM headroom (GB)
fields.description: RAM left for the system when Maya sizes its pinned expert tier. This is engine-native and is not VisLlama Calculated fitting.
fields.source: Project Maya maya.py / docs/SETTINGS.md; see definition evidence.

fields.label: Fixed RAM tier (GB)
fields.description: Optional fixed expert RAM tier. Leave unset for Maya to size from free RAM.
fields.source: Project Maya maya.py / docs/SETTINGS.md; see definition evidence.

fields.label: Keep all off-card experts in RAM
fields.description: 1 requires every expert outside VRAM to fit in RAM; startup fails if it cannot. 0 leaves normal tiering.
fields.source: Project Maya maya.py / docs/SETTINGS.md; see definition evidence.

fields.label: CPU expert threads
fields.description: Threads for the RAM-tier expert CPU lane; 0 disables it. Imported calibration is retained.
fields.source: Project Maya maya.py / docs/SETTINGS.md; see definition evidence.

fields.label: PCIe expert share
fields.description: Engine-native share sent over PCIe instead of CPU computation. Leave unset to retain Maya tuning.
fields.source: Project Maya maya.py / docs/SETTINGS.md; see definition evidence.

fields.label: SSD read chunks
fields.description: Chunks per expert read, 1–16. Preserve calibrated values unless testing a change.
fields.source: Project Maya maya.py / docs/SETTINGS.md; see definition evidence.

fields.label: Disable MTP drafting
fields.description: 1 disables native MTP drafting; 0 allows the engine default. This does not prepare a separate drafter.
fields.source: Project Maya maya.py / docs/SETTINGS.md; see definition evidence.

fields.label: Persistent expert usage file
fields.description: Optional writable usage file. Use a different file for simultaneous models; Maya writes it after requests. Leaving it unset preserves the native default.
fields.source: Project Maya maya.py / docs/SETTINGS.md; see definition evidence.

fields.label: Conversation slot directory
fields.description: Writable native conversation cache directory. Maya normally uses <pack>/slots and may clear it at startup. Use separate directories for simultaneous instances.
fields.source: Project Maya maya.py / docs/SETTINGS.md; see definition evidence.

fields.label: CPU timing cache file
fields.description: Optional writable native timing cache. Use separate files for simultaneous instances. VisLlama does not run setup calibration.
fields.source: Project Maya maya.py / docs/SETTINGS.md; see definition evidence.

Direct prepared server launch uses --engine strata despite the Maya product name. GLM --glm-pack contract only; not the separate maya-ds4 contract. Source/fixture validation only, no hardware acceptance. No setup wrappers, refresh_engine, calibration or repacking invoked. Native --help and argument parsing reviewed in src/program/generate.cpp blob d02cb7877e1264153bb6fbd173686ce9e125acd7; Maya environment-name precedence reviewed in tools/maya_names.py blob def506751a7b270e6eff1e4018b634329c2ea955.

executable.label: Maya server Python interpreter
executable.description: Prepared Maya .venv Python. Runs serve/server.py directly; does not run Maya setup, downloads or rebuilds. Windows: .venv/Scripts/python.exe. Linux: .venv/bin/python.

runtime_executable.label: Maya GLM inference executable
runtime_executable.description: Prepared build/maya.exe (Windows), build/maya (Linux), or build-hip/maya. Separate from the server interpreter. Do not use maya-ds4.
